name: kerryback-skills

plugins.name: litdb
plugins.description: Personal literature + notes knowledge base: hybrid keyword+semantic search over your papers and notes, Zotero/Better BibTeX import, loose-PDF folder ingestion with full text, OpenAlex/Semantic Scholar discovery, and a citation graph. Local-first; the runtime installs into ~/.litdb on first use.

plugins.name: participation
plugins.description: Score class participation from a photo roster. Import Banner's Course Roster PDF to get every student's name and headshot, then tap 1-3 for amount and quality with optional notes while the class is fresh. Writes a row per student per meeting to participation.csv in the course's own folder. Local-first; the runtime installs into ~/.participation on first use.

plugins.name: voiceover
plugins.description: Turn a PDF slide deck into a narrated MP4 video plus a transcript. Claude Code writes the per-slide narration; ElevenLabs voices it. Requires quarto and an ElevenLabs API key.

plugins.name: smithers
plugins.description: A personal email and calendar desk. Claude Code reads your Gmail and Calendar through a local connector, writes an overview of what’s ahead for the next seven days, and parks drafted replies in a Compose tab you review and send yourself. Claude never sends mail and never deletes events — those stay your actions in the app. Local-first; state and Google tokens live in ~/.smithers.

plugins.name: slides
plugins.description: Build a polished slide deck as a Quarto reveal.js presentation — HTML slides you render, present in a browser, and export to PDF, PowerPoint, or PNG.

plugins.name: finance-data
plugins.description: Fetch free financial, market, and economic data (prices, fundamentals, SEC filings, macro series, asset-pricing factors) from Yahoo, Stooq, SEC EDGAR, FRED, Ken French, FinnHub, FMP, and US Treasury, and save it as CSV.

plugins.name: wrds
plugins.description: Empirical asset-pricing data from WRDS (CRSP v2/Compustat) and Open Source Asset Pricing: extractable Python building blocks for connect, pull, merge, market cap aggregated across share classes, the CRSP-Compustat link, book equity, accounting alignment and firm age — every query run against live WRDS. Surfaces the constructions that are genuine decisions rather than common practice (Ken French vs Drechsler's WRDS script vs OpenAP, and the 4- vs 6-month reporting lag) instead of picking silently, and ships twelve WRDS reference scripts.

plugins.name: critique
plugins.description: Critique and revise work produced by Claude. Spawns parallel reviewer agents, synthesizes findings, and applies revisions. Heavyweight — fans out multiple subagents.

plugins.name: coauthor
plugins.description: A coordinated multi-agent system for empirical research papers. Claude Code is the coordinator you converse with; a diverse OpenRouter debate panel (Proposer, Adversary) generates and attacks ideas; tool-using Claude subagents ground the work in fact (Verifier over litdb), independently build the data and run the empirics (Analyst), and independently re-derive both the data build and the results (Replicator). Domain-agnostic; data-source access lives in a separate data plugin. Runs in any directory, keeping everything in a local .coauthor/ folder; creates no repos.

plugins.name: human-write
plugins.description: Write and edit academic prose that reads as human, not machine-generated: varied sentence rhythm, no formulaic AI tells (delve, however-at-every-turn, the not-X-but-Y contrast, three-item everything), and structure driven by the argument rather than a template. Defaults to scholarly register (journal articles, working papers, referee reports, grant proposals). Works when drafting fresh and when revising a draft.

plugins.name: cloning
plugins.description: Clone your own voice on ElevenLabs, end to end: account and plan setup for newcomers, a reading script drafted from your own slides and papers so the clone learns your vocabulary and teaching cadence, guidance for recording it fresh in one sitting, and an automated ffmpeg QC pass that catches bad audio before you spend your one professional cloning slot, and verification of the finished voice.

plugins.name: elegant-pdf
plugins.description: Create elegant, branded documents from a small HTML design system rendered to PDF or image with headless Chrome — one-page flyers/announcements (2x JPEG or clickable PDF) and multi-page programs, reports, and handbooks (clickable PDF with cover, running footer, and page numbers). Default palette is Rice Business navy + gold; recolor by editing one block.

description: Authoring and teaching skills for Claude Code: narrated video from slide decks, Quarto slide decks, free financial/economic data, and adversarial work review.
